title: SBI data leak: Nearly 4,000 customer records found on dark web; what we know so far
content: In a concerning development, the State Bank of India has initiated an investigation following the exposure of 3,897 customer records on the dark web. Allegations suggest that a hacker group obtained sensitive personally identifiable information, such as names, mobile numbers, and addresses. Despite these alarming findings, SBI has assured that its essential operations remain unaffected and are functioning normally, while ongoing evaluations and corrective actions are being put in place.

title: ‘Dead letter box’, Rs 80,000: How 2 women supplied weapons to Tiger Shroff’s shooters
content: Investigators have reportedly found a weapons supply network in connection with the firing incident involving Tiger Shroff's car. Two accused allegedly traveled to Amritsar to collect firearms, sourced through a dead letter box. Anil Pandit is believed to have orchestrated these operations while compensating the accused for their involvement. The accused initially intended to target a different Bollywood celebrity before shifting to Shroff.

title: 'Pay community dividend': Trump's message to companies building massive data centres
content: Donald Trump has proposed that large data centres should generate their own electricity and sell surplus power. He emphasized the potential for lower electricity prices through this model for local communities and the grid. Companies are encouraged to provide financial benefits to increase acceptance of data centre projects. Trump has linked the expansion of these centres to competition with China in artificial intelligence.

title: 'We have plans for Vaibhav Sooryavanshi': Santner sends warning to India
content: New Zealand captain Mitchell Santner believes Vaibhav Sooryavanshi could be a tough batter to stop if he gets a chance in India's playing XI for the five-match T20I series. The series begins on Thursday, and Santner said his team has already worked on plans to deal with the young left-hander.

title: Qualcomm layoffs: CEO says job cuts target areas falling short of expectations
content: Qualcomm plans to implement global layoffs in response to performance evaluations and organizational needs. CEO Cristiano Amon has stated that job cuts will start in November this year. The company aims to create a stronger performance culture to meet business priorities. Despite recent challenges, Qualcomm expects to achieve growth in non-handset sectors by fiscal 2027.

title: Wisconsin farmer fights $900m power line that could cross 120 acres of farm
content: In western Wisconsin, rural landowners are rallying against the MariBell Transmission Project due to its anticipated negative impact on their land. The proposed route threatens family farms, with fears of diminished usable land, decreased property values, and potential health concerns. As the regulatory process moves forward, legal actions have emerged against the developers, accompanied by vigorous public protests, showcasing the strong resistance from the community of farmers and residents.

title: Man repeatedly sent unsuitable matrimony profiles; commission orders Rs 37,000 relief
content: A consumer commission in Kerala has criticized a matrimonial agency for not fulfilling its service promises. The agency engaged in unfair trade practices, deceiving clients into buying pricier packages. In response to a complaint by Akhil Vinod, the commission mandated a refund and additional compensation. They highlighted the importance of matrimonial agencies transparently detailing their services to prevent consumer deception.

title: Taxman caps SBI retiree’s leave exemption at Rs 3 lakh; but ITAT grants full relief
content: Under income tax law, SBI staff are treated as non-government employees and, therefore, can claim leave encashment exemption subject to the applicable limit. A retired SBI employee from Jaipur, was unaware of this distinction. When he retired in 2020 he received Rs 9.29 lakh as leave encashment and did not pay tax on the amount.

title: Influencer with 1.3 million followers dies by suicide in Chennai
content: V Harish, a 27-year-old social media influencer, was found dead in Chennai after alleged cyberbullying. His father accused another influencer, Jason Samuel, of causing severe mental distress through defamatory posts. Harish's online channels were reported and blocked multiple times, contributing to his emotional turmoil. Before his death, he recorded a video blaming Samuel for his situation. Police have registered a case and are investigating the claims made by both parties.

title: Kaley Cuoco's 40-acre California ranch is now a refuge for rescued animals
content: In 2017, The Big Bang Theorystar Kaley Cuoco purchased a 40-acre ranch in California for $4.99 million. Nine years later, the property has become a refuge for rescued horses, cows, goats, pigs, donkeys and birds. Cuoco has transformed the ranch into a home for animals, including older ones rescued from difficult conditions, while also making it an important part of her family life.

title: Chance the Rapper's charity backed Chicago youth therapy with $100,000 grant
content: Chance the Rapper's philanthropic venture, SocialWorks, has dedicated itself to bolstering mental health support for Chicago’s youth. By funding Under the Rainbow, a therapy initiative aimed at trauma-affected young individuals, SocialWorks strives to enhance access to emotional aid and nurture safe healing spaces. This initiative is part of a broader mission to uplift community well-being and empower the next generation by tackling pressing mental health issues.

title: Zuckerberg’s wife Priscilla Chan marks 10 years in Hawaii, donates $1.48m to hospital
content: In a remarkable gesture of generosity, Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan have contributed $1.48 million to the Wilcox Medical Center in Kauaʻi. This donation will be utilized to purchase a mobile MRI unit and a 3D mammography machine, reinforcing their decade-long commitment to enhancing healthcare in the community. Overall, their philanthropy has exceeded $4 million, fundamentally improving access to vital medical resources for local residents.

title: Florida couple missed 66 mortgage payments; man's bank lawsuit rejected
content: A Florida couple missed 66 monthly mortgage payments on their Naples property, triggering a foreclosure dispute that began in 2009. During the legal battle, Gregory Brian Myers agreed to deposit $5,000 monthly while appealing the foreclosure. He later sued U.S. Bank, alleging it had violated their agreement. On October 19, 2026, a federal appeals court upheld the dismissal of his lawsuit.

title: Who is IPS Ankita Sharma? AK-47 video goes viral; UPSC AIR 203 on third attempt
content: IPS officer Ankita Sharma is in the spotlight after a video showed her firing an AK-47 during Dussehra’s traditional weapon worship ceremony in Rajnandgaon, Chhattisgarh. The incident drew mixed reactions on social media, with some praising her confidence while others raised safety concerns. A 2018-batch officer, Sharma secured All India Rank 203 in the UPSC Civil Services Examination on her third attempt. Her journey includes early academic struggles, two unsuccessful UPSC attempts and a career in policing.

title: Nazi-looted Kandinsky returned to Jewish heirs sells for £31.56m
content: A painting by Wassily Kandinsky, titled Das bunte Leben, sold at auction for £31.56 million. This artwork was returned to the heirs of its original Jewish owners after decades of dispute. The piece was originally painted in 1907 and displayed at notable exhibitions. Following its theft by the Nazis, it changed hands multiple times before being held by a German bank.

title: 'Damning photos': Oppn targets Hardeep Puri's 'private meeting' pic with Epstein
content: Leaders from Congress, TMC, and NCP have voiced strong disapproval of Hardeep Singh Puri for his dealings with Jeffrey Epstein. Puri has contended that his interactions came during a professional delegation after his ambassadorial tenure. Critics are calling for clarification about the substance of these encounters, emphasizing their concerns over the ramifications of Puri's associations with someone linked to serious criminal charges.

title: Tamera Mowry lists home for $2.69m after buying 15-acre Napa estate for $3.8m
content: Tamera Mowry-Housley and Adam Housley are making waves in real estate as they list their picturesque Fairfield, California home for $2.69 million. Having acquired a quaint Napa Valley estate that requires renovations, their vision focuses on sustainable living with an orchard and vineyard to nurture their children's outdoor adventures. This shift marks a profound transformation in their family lifestyle, moving from spacious interiors to embracing more land and nature.

title: 2 injured in explosion at under-construction building in Bengaluru
content: At least two construction workers were injured in an explosion at a building site in Bengaluru. The incident occurred on Jarmia Road and has raised security concerns. Following the explosion, officials from various divisions inspected the site to assess potential risks. The injured workers were admitted to Bowring Hospital for medical treatment. An investigation is underway to determine the cause of the explosion.

title: 'Can't walk in right now': Iyer says Sooryavanshi has 'years to get opportunities'
content: Shreyas Iyer has suggested that young talent Vaibhav Sooryavanshi might need to be patient regarding his opportunities in the playing XI. With seasoned openers like Abhishek Sharma and Sanju Samson in fine form, Iyer believes that the experience Sooryavanshi gained from prior tours will significantly aid his growth. He stressed the importance of nurturing a comfortable team atmosphere for the player's continued development.

title: Jio IPO fully subscribed in just 100 minutes of opening
content: Jio IPO: The rapid subscription was notable because large IPOs in India often see a slow start, with institutional investors typically placing their bids closer to the closing deadline. By comparison, the National Stock Exchange of India's share sale recently attracted subscriptions for just 42% of the shares on offer on its first day

title: Avengers Assemble: From Captain America to Spider-Man, superheroes run wild in France
content: Recent protests in France saw participants dressed as superheroes like Captain America, Batman, and Spider-Man. While demonstrations began with student grievances, they broadened to include various groups united against rising living costs. In cities like Marseille and Paris, clashes with police erupted, where costumed figures captured attention amid the unrest. Additionally, historical figures such as Napoleon were also spotted among demonstrators.

title: Harmanpreet Kaur breaks down on live TV, reveals what has changed
content: Harmanpreet Kaur achieved a remarkable performance by scoring 91 runs against Zimbabwe in a recent T20I. Her innings marked a significant comeback after struggling for form in previous matches. She expressed gratitude towards those who supported her during challenging times in her career. After stepping down as captain, she found relief and confidence to enjoy her game once more.

title: Jio IPO: QIB portion fully subscribed at over 2x demand within minutes
content: Jio Platforms IPO is open for subscription from October 21 to October 23. The company, which houses the telecom and digital businesses of the Mukesh Ambani-led group, plans to issue around 27 crore shares at a price band of Rs 1,065 to Rs 1,119 per share. The offering is expected to raise approximately Rs 30,213 crore.

title: Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann 'detained for 3 hours' at Delhi airport, fined Rs 50k
content: Aam Aadmi Party has alleged that Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann was detained at Delhi airport recently. He was held for three hours and subsequently issued a challan of Rs 50,000. AAP officials claim this incident reflects a deliberate attempt to humiliate Mann by the BJP-led central government. The party asserts that this move undermines the dignity of Punjab.

title: Mother, lover, son kill 13-year-old twins who opposed their relationship
content: In Badesra village, two twin brothers, Vinay and Vishnu Chaudhary, were found murdered on Tuesday morning. Their mother, Preeti, allegedly conspired with her paramour to kill them due to their opposition to her relationship. The police discovered the bodies showing multiple injuries, including slit throats and head wounds. Preeti's 16-year-old son also participated in the crime, supporting his mother.

title: Can a magistrate summon you for extortion without evidence? Patna HC answers
content: Recently, the Patna high court dismissed a criminal case citing insufficient evidence to support the extortion claims. The court highlighted that the allegations did not fulfill the legal criteria set by the Indian Penal Code. Moreover, the accused was absent during the incidents detailed in the complaint, pointing out misuse of the legal system for personal vendettas. This ruling emphasized the importance of adhering to due process in criminal matters.

title: Murder FIR on 10-yr-old girl for pushing toddler from sixth floor in Mumbai
content: An 18-month-old toddler fell to her death from a sixth-floor stairwell in Goregaon. Police registered a murder FIR against her 10-year-old neighbor based on the mother's complaint. The child's mother stated that the older girl had gestured for her daughter to approach her. After the incident, the 10-year-old was placed in counseling through an NGO. Experts emphasize the importance of rehabilitation for the young girl rather than punitive measures.

title: Who is next Republican nominee for US Prez? Vance expects endorsement; Trump says 'no'
content: US President Donald Trump has declined to endorse Vice President JD Vance for the 2028 presidential election. While Vance expects Trump's support if he runs, Trump did not commit to backing him. Trump stated there are many capable individuals who could succeed him in the future. Vance acknowledged he hadn't discussed his candidacy directly with Trump. Both their remarks highlight the uncertain nature of the upcoming Republican nomination contest.

title: Family cruise trip cancelled without notice; commission orders Rs 54K payout
content: A family's dream cruise was abruptly canceled without warning, leaving them in distress. The District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission in Kerala found both the holiday company and cruise operator at fault. Despite repeated attempts to secure a refund after the cancellation, the complainant was denied compensation. The commission mandated a refund along with additional compensation for the trouble caused, allowing one month for compliance before penalties escalate.

title: AI boom set to push Big Tech investment beyond $1 trillion in 2027, says UBS
content: By 2027, big tech companies are projected to invest more than $1 trillion in AI infrastructure, fueled by soaring demand. This surge in investment is anticipated to enhance the US economy, potentially adding about 0.75 percentage points to GDP growth. Still, firms are grappling with mounting cash flow pressures and declining bond demand.

title: Delhi BJP leader burns cockroach effigy; Dipke responds with SRK’s 'Swades' song
content: During Dussehra celebrations in Delhi, a 30-foot cockroach effigy was burned alongside traditional effigies of Ravan. Organizers stated that the effigy symbolized filth and promoted cleanliness in line with health awareness initiatives. Leaders of the Cockroach Janta Party reacted sharply, suggesting the move provided them with free publicity. Delhi minister Kapil Mishra remarked that cockroaches symbolize chaos and filth, reflecting public sentiment.

title: More trouble for CJP leaders: Another FIR against Das, Ranka transferred to Crime Branch
content: Delhi Police has transferred two FIRs against Cockroach Janta Party leaders to the Crime Branch for investigation. The leaders, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, were detained during protests at Connaught Place and Jantar Mantar. Legal challenges have been filed by their team to contest an extension of their judicial custody. They claim their continued detention violates their fundamental rights and due process.

title: Rupee gains 29 paise against dollar in early trade, but crude prices limit gains
content: On Wednesday, the Rupee saw an impressive rise of nearly 0.5% against the US Dollar, marking its highest point in six weeks. This boost was fueled by strong foreign currency inflows from the Jio IPO and positive movements in the equity markets. Nonetheless, high crude oil prices presented challenges for the domestic currency, with the dollar index inching up and Brent crude futures rising notably.

title: Jio IPO opens for subscription: Price band, GMP to brokerage views
content: Jio Platforms IPO: The company has fixed the price band at Rs 1,065 to Rs 1,119 per share. Based on the offer documents, the IPO values the company at around $108 billion. Investors will be able to apply for Jio Platforms shares in lots of 12, or in multiples of 12 shares.

title: Bavuma enters record books with captain’s knock as SA produce great fightback
content: Temba Bavuma achieved his highest Test score of 179, helping South Africa recover from a challenging position. The captain's performance was vital as the team declared at 425-9 after being down 110-6. Marco Jansen supported Bavuma with a significant 85 runs, and Simon Harmer contributed 82 runs. The innings included impressive partnerships that shifted the momentum in favor of South Africa.

title: Day after 3 Meiteis killed, Kuki man shot dead as Manipur violence escalates
content: Paolenmung Thangeo, a 45-year-old Kuki tribesman, was killed by gunmen while collecting bamboo shoots. This incident took place in Kangpokpi, Manipur, amidst rising tensions. His companion managed to escape unharmed during the attack. Just a day earlier, three Meitei villagers were ambushed and killed in the same area. Authorities have begun investigations, resulting in the arrest of three suspects connected to the earlier incident.

title: Asian Para Games: Sachin wins gold as India sweep all three shot put medals
content: India won all three medals in the men’s shot put F46 event at the Asian Para Games on Wednesday, with Sachin Sarjerao Khilari taking gold with a Games record. Khilari, a silver medallist at the Paris Paralympics, defended the gold he had won at the previous edition of the Games in China. He produced his best throw of 15.87m with his sixth and final attempt to set a new Games record.

title: CJP's Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka move Delhi HC; cases handed to Crime Branch
content: Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka have approached the Delhi High Court to challenge their judicial custody. They were detained after climbing a gate to protest at Jantar Mantar on October 13. The initial five-day custody was followed by a two-day extension, which expires on Wednesday. Their case has been transferred to the Crime Branch for further investigation and handling.

title: ‘Who will talk to me, and why?’: Shami’s blunt take after selectors overlook him
content: Mohammed Shami is determined to fight for his place in the Indian cricket team. He insists that he remains in peak fitness and continues to focus on domestic cricket. Shami completed the previous domestic season and aims to stay prepared for future series and tournaments. While he welcomed Bhuvneshwar Kumar's return, he voiced concerns about communications with selectors. Shami emphasizes the importance of loyalty and dedication to his team, Bengal.

title: Trump wants ‘New America’ for New Mexico, reviving debate on America’s name
content: Donald Trump proposed renaming New Mexico to New America, claiming it would enhance pride among residents and change election integrity. Political representatives from New Mexico opposed the idea, emphasizing the state's historical significance and established name. Constitutional barriers exist, as name changes require formal processes involving local and national laws. Historical context surrounding America’s naming is complex and reflects a mix of cultural influences.

content: The circular directs that an updated list of the medicine stocks in hospitals be provided to doctors in the OP (outpatient) departments. This will help doctors have a clear idea about the medicines available in the hospital and to prescribe the same to patients.
